queries.sql:
WITH revenue_plan AS (
        SELECT p.period, p.dim_secondary, SUM(p.amount) AS plan_revenue
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        WHERE p.version_id = 2
          AND p.account_code IN (SELECT account_code FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE statement_section = 'Revenue' AND is_leaf = TRUE)
          AND p.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-12'
          
        GROUP BY p.period, p.dim_secondary
      ),
      revenue_actual AS (
        SELECT a.period, a.dim_secondary, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS actual_revenue
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.plan_account_code IN (SELECT account_code FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE statement_section = 'Revenue' AND is_leaf = TRUE)
          AND a.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-12'
          
        GROUP BY a.period, a.dim_secondary
      )
      SELECT
        COALESCE(rp.period, ra.period) AS period,
        COALESCE(rp.dim_secondary, ra.dim_secondary) AS dim_secondary,
        COALESCE(rp.plan_revenue, 0) AS plan_revenue,
        COALESCE(ra.actual_revenue, 0) AS actual_revenue
      FROM revenue_plan rp
      FULL OUTER JOIN revenue_actual ra
        ON rp.period = ra.period AND rp.dim_secondary = ra.dim_secondary
      ORDER BY period, dim_secondary
